# GitHub

> > GitHub is the world's leading AI-powered developer platform for version control, collaboration, and software development with integrated tools like GitHub Copilot, Actions, and Codespaces.

GitHub provides a comprehensive ecosystem for developers including Git repository hosting, CI/CD automation, cloud development environments, code security, and AI-assisted coding. The platform serves millions of developers and organizations building open-source and private software projects.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- GitHub Actions
- GitHub Codespaces
- Git version control
- CI/CD automation
- AI coding assistant
- Open-source collaboration
- Code review
- GitHub Advanced Security
- Developer tools
- GitHub CLI
- SSH authentication
- GitHub Packages
- Cloud development
- GitHub Marketplace

## Core Platform

- [GitHub Homepage](https://github.com/): AI-powered developer platform homepage featuring GitHub Copilot & Actions
- [GitHub Features](https://github.com/features): Overview of GitHub features: Copilot, Actions, Codespaces, and Packages
- [Official GitHub Organization](https://github.com/github): Official GitHub organization profile with 535 repos and open-source tools
- [GitHub Desktop](https://desktop.github.com/): Desktop Git client for simplified version control and collaboration workflow

## Documentation & Guides

- [GitHub Documentation](https://docs.github.com/): Documentation hub for GitHub products, Copilot, Codespaces, and guides
- [SSH Key Setup Guide](https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/connecting-to-github-with-ssh/adding-a-new-ssh-key-to-your-github-account): Tutorial for configuring SSH key authentication for GitHub account access

## Marketplace & Extensions

- [GitHub Marketplace](https://github.com/marketplace): GitHub Marketplace for AI models, developer tools, and workflow automation

## Optional

- [Trending Repositories](https://github.com/trending): Daily trending repositories featuring AI, ML, and open-source projects
